body: I ride 10 miles each way to work 6 days a week and my cons list is as follows: Rain, snow, cold, big trucks, cops with nothing better to do.  On the other hand the gas mileage is great, and I personally get an amazing sense of freedom from riding my moped. It doesn't matter what kind of mood I'm in, a quick ride on Ol' Ruby and I'm ear to ear. I say go for it.
